name: Daisuke
source:
A procrastinating young man who is at a crossroad in his life, trying to figure out what direction he wants to go academically. On top of this, he is also looking for a girlfriend. He lives on his own after being kicked out by his own father. His name is a play on words of the Japanese term "dai suki", which means "I love you".

Name could be changed by player.
